def _mob(me, opp):
    return (((me << 1) & opp).bit_count()
            + ((me >> 1) & opp).bit_count()
            + ((me << STRIDE) & opp).bit_count()
            + ((me >> STRIDE) & opp).bit_count())

def _eval(me, opp):

            + (me.bit_count() - opp.bit_count()))

def _gen(me, opp):
    moves = []
    t = (me << 1) & opp
    while t:
        b = t & -t
        j = b.bit_length() - 1
        t ^= b
        moves.append((j - 1, j))
    t = (me >> 1) & opp
    while t:
        b = t & -t
        j = b.bit_length() - 1
        t ^= b

        j = b.bit_length() - 1

        moves.append((j - STRIDE, j))
    t = (me >> STRIDE) & opp
    while t:
        b = t & -t
        j = b.bit_length() - 1
        t ^= b
        moves.append((j + STRIDE, j))
    return moves
